title: Apartamento T1+1 para venda
description:
Este apartamento duplex T1+1 insere-se num prédio de pequena dimensão, composto apenas por rés do chão e primeiro andar, proporcionando um ambiente calmo e familiar. Localizado logo à entrada de Ribeira de Frades, beneficia de excelentes acessos e da proximidade à cidade de Coimbra, a apenas 5 minutos, conciliando tranquilidade com conveniência urbana.

1+1 Bedroom Duplex Apartment in a Prime Location.

This 1+1 bedroom duplex apartment is part of a small residential building, consisting only of ground floor and first floor units, providing a quiet and family-friendly environment.

Located right at the entrance of Ribeira de Frades, it benefits from excellent access routes and close proximity to the city of Coimbra, just 5 minutes away, combining tranquility with urban convenience.

Currently under construction, the property will be delivered brand new and ready to move into from May 2026, standing out for the quality of materials, comfort, and high energy efficiency.

Property Features:

1+1 bedroom apartment located on the first floor

Attic space with approximately 50 m²

New construction with contemporary design and quality materials

Energy Certificate A

Two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, one of which is a suite

Two bathrooms (one private en-suite)

Modern and functional open-plan kitchen connected to the living room

Excellent natural light

Comfort and Efficiency:

Pre-installation for air conditioning
